batch_name: Google ADK Specialized Tool Agents to CrewAI
pattern: Tool-based workflows (ADK tools → CrewAI custom tools)

apps.name: Antom Payment
apps.description: Payment processing integration with transaction validation and receipt generation

agents.goal: Validate payment requests and ensure compliance with security and regulatory standards
Process payments efficiently and securely, generating confirmations and receipts

custom_tools.name: PaymentGatewayTool
custom_tools.description: Processes payments through various payment gateways with support for multiple currencies and payment methods

custom_tools.name: TransactionValidatorTool
custom_tools.description: Validates payment transactions for compliance, fraud detection, and data integrity

custom_tools.name: ReceiptGeneratorTool
custom_tools.description: Generates payment receipts and sends them to customers

apps.workflow: Sequential: Validate transaction → Process payment → Generate receipt

apps.name: Brand Search Optimization
apps.description: SEO and search optimization with keyword research and content optimization

agents.goal: Analyze keywords and search trends to identify the best opportunities for brand visibility
Optimize website content for search engines while maintaining quality and user experience

custom_tools.name: SEOAnalyzerTool
custom_tools.description: Analyzes website SEO metrics including on-page optimization, technical SEO, and performance

custom_tools.name: KeywordResearchTool
custom_tools.description: Finds relevant keywords with search volume, competition, and trend data

custom_tools.name: RankingTrackerTool
custom_tools.description: Monitors search engine rankings for specified keywords and domains

apps.workflow: Sequential: Research keywords → Analyze and optimize content

apps.name: Image Scoring
apps.description: Visual content evaluation with computer vision and quality assessment

agents.goal: Analyze image quality, content, and composition using computer vision techniques
Calculate comprehensive image scores based on technical, aesthetic, and content quality

custom_tools.name: VisionAnalysisTool
custom_tools.description: Performs computer vision analysis on images including object detection, scene understanding, and quality assessment

custom_tools.name: QualityScorerTool
custom_tools.description: Scores image quality based on technical metrics, composition, and aesthetic appeal

custom_tools.name: ContentDetectionTool
custom_tools.description: Detects specific content in images including objects, faces, text, and inappropriate content

apps.workflow: Sequential: Analyze image → Calculate comprehensive scores

apps.name: LLM Auditor
apps.description: Model performance assessment with benchmarking and comprehensive reporting

agents.goal: Test LLM performance across multiple dimensions including accuracy, speed, and quality
Generate comprehensive audit reports from performance data and metrics

custom_tools.name: ModelEvaluationTool
custom_tools.description: Evaluates LLM responses across multiple criteria including accuracy, relevance, coherence, and safety

custom_tools.name: BenchmarkTool
custom_tools.description: Runs comprehensive performance benchmarks on LLMs including standard tasks and custom evaluations

custom_tools.name: MetricsAggregatorTool
custom_tools.description: Aggregates performance metrics from multiple evaluations and benchmarks into comprehensive reports

apps.workflow: Sequential: Test performance → Aggregate metrics and generate report

apps.name: Safety Plugins
apps.description: Safety feature integration with content moderation and risk assessment

agents.goal: Moderate content for safety, filtering inappropriate material and detecting toxicity
Assess safety risks and provide recommendations for content handling and mitigation

custom_tools.name: ContentFilterTool
custom_tools.description: Filters unsafe content including profanity, violence, hate speech, and inappropriate material

custom_tools.name: ToxicityDetectorTool
custom_tools.description: Detects toxic content including harassment, threats, insults, and identity attacks

custom_tools.name: RiskScorerTool
custom_tools.description: Scores content for various safety risks including legal, reputational, and user safety concerns

apps.workflow: Sequential: Moderate content → Assess risks and recommend actions

apps.name: Travel Concierge
apps.description: Trip planning and management with itinerary creation and booking services

agents.goal: Plan detailed travel itineraries that match traveler preferences and optimize their experience
Handle all travel bookings efficiently, securing the best options and confirming reservations

custom_tools.name: TravelAPITool
custom_tools.description: Searches for flights, hotels, and activities using travel APIs with real-time pricing and availability

custom_tools.name: BookingTool
custom_tools.description: Makes reservations for flights, hotels, and activities with confirmation and payment processing

custom_tools.name: ItineraryBuilderTool
custom_tools.description: Creates detailed travel itineraries with daily schedules, activities, and recommendations

apps.workflow: Sequential: Plan itinerary → Make bookings and confirm reservations

migration_approach.strategy: Convert ADK specialized tools to CrewAI custom tools with Pydantic validation
key_changes: Replaced ADK tool integrations with custom CrewAI tools
Implemented type-safe tool inputs using Pydantic models
Created specialized agent roles for each domain
Added comprehensive error handling and validation

key_improvements.modularity: Custom tools are reusable across agents and apps
key_improvements.type_safety: Pydantic models ensure input validation and type checking
key_improvements.extensibility: Easy to add new tools and agents without modifying existing code
key_improvements.error_handling: Built-in validation with clear error messages
key_improvements.consistency: All apps follow the same architectural pattern

common_files: main.py - Entry point and crew orchestration
agents.py - Agent definitions with roles and tools
tasks.py - Task definitions with descriptions and expected outputs
tools.py - Custom tool implementations with Pydantic schemas

implementation_highlights.innovation: Multi-gateway payment processing with fraud detection and automated receipt generation
Integrated keyword research and content optimization with ranking tracking
Multi-dimensional image quality assessment with aesthetic and technical scoring
Comprehensive LLM auditing with benchmarking and automated report generation
Layered safety approach with filtering, toxicity detection, and risk assessment
End-to-end travel planning with personalized itineraries and automated booking

testing_recommendations: Test each tool independently with various input scenarios
Validate sequential workflow execution across all apps
Verify error handling for invalid inputs
Test integration with external APIs (payment, travel, etc.)
Validate LLM responses for each agent role
deployment_notes: All apps require ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable
Install dependencies using: pip install -r requirements.txt
Run each app using: python main.py
Test tools with mock data before production deployment
Monitor agent performance and adjust prompts as needed
future_enhancements: Add parallel processing for independent tool operations
Create web interfaces for each app
Add support for multiple LLM providers
Create shared tool library for cross-app reuse
notes: All apps successfully converted from Google ADK to CrewAI framework
Custom tools created for each specialized domain with proper validation
Sequential workflow pattern maintained for clear task dependencies
Tool-based architecture enables modular, reusable components
Each app follows consistent file structure and naming conventions
Comprehensive documentation provided for each component
Ready for testing and deployment with minimal configuration
lessons_learned: Pydantic models significantly improve tool input validation
Sequential workflows work well for dependent tasks
Custom tools provide flexibility for domain-specific requirements
Agent role specialization improves output quality
Consistent architecture patterns ease maintenance and scalability

success_metrics.code_quality: All apps use type hints and Pydantic validation
success_metrics.documentation: Complete README and inline documentation for all components
success_metrics.completeness: All 6 apps fully implemented with all required files
success_metrics.reusability: Tools and agents designed for maximum reusability
